results.title: 10 Ways to Fix a Spacebar That's Not Working Properly
results.content:
Has your spacebar suddenly stopped working? This is a frustrating issue, especially if you use your computer for work, school, or fun. In this article we'll go over all the ways you can try to fix your spacebar, including cleaning it, fixing keyboard drivers, and more.

## Top Tips for Fixing a Broken Spacebar

Tech specialist Luigi Oppido says many spacebar problems are due to dirt particles stuck under the key. Clean under the spacebar with compressed air. If that doesn't work, plug your keyboard into a different computer to check for connection issues. Update your system and run a malware scan in case of software problems.

## Steps

1

### Remove Dust From the Spacebar

1. Remove debris from under the keys on your keyboard. [...] 1. Remove debris from under the keys on your keyboard.

   Remove debris from under the keys on your keyboard. Dust in your keyboard is one of the most common reasons behind a spacebar that doesn't work. To clean under the spacebar and remove dust, use a can of compressed air. Position the nozzle under and around the key and spray, using the air to dislodge dirt, crumbs, or other debris that could be under there.(#_note-1) X Research source 
    Don't turn the can of compressed air upside down and spray. This will cause the propellant to be sprayed out of the can, which could damage your keyboard. This propellant is also very cold, and could cause injury.
